items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I spoke to Wendell Echols who was a production coordinator.

ctx.x: You never know, you may be favored.

Well, I spoke to Wendell Echols who was a production coordinator. He didn't get to the last session that we made, but he's heard the tape and they're quite pleased with it. I was kind of tired when we made it, but I'm happy to note it turned out all right and of course I did hear the tape of the album that I made at the same time we made "We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye." And that's a very good album, too.
